notes.title: Ancient Battle: Successors Update version 3.0.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Support for the Metal graphics system on all Apple devices, improving graphics performance.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Unit will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
[*] Fix: An issue with image scaling on older Apple iOS devices.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Fix: Sometimes the side flags do not appear.
[*] Update: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been selected and completed.
[/list]
